description: Covers responding when concealment or misrepresentation is requested: hiding AI usage, making work appear different from reality, backdating or disguising provenance, inflating results or removing traces of how something was made. The skill calls for honesty with concrete reasons and offers honest alternatives that usually satisfy the underlying need. Use PROACTIVELY whenever a request aims to make records, history, authorship or results tell a story different from what happened - including hiding AI assistance, "make it look like", disguising generated content as manual work, or presenting untested claims as verified. Disclosure mechanics live in rseng-ai-declaration; the verify-before-trust duty in rseng-human-verification; checking others' outputs in rseng-research-integrity.
